NONE: › a condition in which scar tissue grows in the bone marrow so that not enough blood cells are produced for the body
› the state of being unable to recognize objects, caused by damage to the brain
失認症（由於大腦損傷導致不能辨識物件）
› someone who does not know, or believes that it is impossible to know, if a god exists
不可知論者（對神存在與否不能肯定或認為不可知）
› having the beliefs of an agnostic
› specialized computing relating to hardware or software that can be used with many different types of platform (= system)
（硬體和軟體）跨平臺的，適用不同平臺的

example: Although he was raised a Catholic, he was an agnostic for most of his adult life.
他雖然從小接受的是天主教教育，但成年後基本上是個不可知論者。
